definitions.explanation: Made from iron or steel. Used as a modifier to describe objects crafted from iron.

examples.japanese: {鉄製|てつせい}のフライパンを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought an iron frying pan.

examples.japanese: この{門|もん}は{鉄製|てつせい}なので{重|おも}い。
examples.english: This gate is heavy because it's made of iron.

examples.japanese: {鉄製|てつせい}の{鍋|なべ}は{手入|てい}れが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
{古|ふる}い{鉄製|てつせい}の{階段|かいだん}が{錆|さ}びて{危険|きけん}な{状態|じょうたい}になっていた。
examples.english: The old iron staircase had rusted and become dangerous.

notes:
Composed of {鉄|てつ} (iron) + {製|せい} (made of). The suffix {製|せい} is highly productive and attaches to material names to indicate what something is made from. Understanding this pattern unlocks many similar compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄製|てつせい}のフライパン: iron frying pan
- {鉄製|てつせい}の{門|もん}: iron gate
- {鉄製|てつせい}の{柵|さく}: iron fence
- {鉄製|てつせい}の{鍋|なべ}: iron pot

SIMILAR PATTERN ({製|せい} compounds):
- {木製|もくせい}: made of wood
- {金属製|きんぞくせい}: made of metal
- {革製|かわせい}: made of leather
- {陶製|とうせい}: made of ceramic
- {銅製|どうせい}: made of copper
- プラスチック{製|せい}: made of plastic
